decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed erection of single-storey rear extension to shop and new staircase and balustrade to upper floor hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission, and the proposed erection of detached outbuilding as contained in the application and amended drawing no. 2633-01 Rev B shall be completed within 6 months from the date of this permission.  Failure to complete the works (outbuilding) will result in enforcement action being implemented.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the buildings are used).

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the west wall of the single-storey rear extension, and west, east and rear walls of the outbuilding, hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The waste and recycled materials storage arrangements shown on the approved drawing shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 6 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to WC, 271 Bath Road shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.

Condition : 7 - The site shall be investigated for landfill gas to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority and details of the test results and measures required to render the development safe shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced.

Where measures are required, they shall be installed before the development is occupied or such other time as may be required by the Local Planning Authority
Condition : 8 - Lighting shall be provided for the staircase accessing the flat above.
Condition : 9 - A disabled toilet shall be provided, details to be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 10 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of single storey rear extension to shop and new staircase and Balustrade to upperfloor and erection of detached outbuilding.
